message.content:
Oversized structured wool blazer, wide lapel cut, knee-length hem, charcoal grey with hex code #36454F, heavy-weight woven fabric.
High-waisted straight-leg dark denim trousers, relaxed fit through thigh, full ankle length, deep indigo with hex code #191A17, sturdy cotton twill fabric.
Chunky knitted crewneck sweater, ribbed trim, longline drape, oat cream with hex code #EFEBE5, soft cashmere blend fabric.
Leather Chelsea boots, chunky heel, ankle cuff, blackened oak with hex code #2C241B, smooth calfskin leather fabric.
Matte gold hoop earrings, medium gauge, circular shape, polished metal, brass alloy fabric.
Minimalist slim watch, rectangular face, leather strap, silver casing with hex code #A9A9A9, stainless steel and genuine leather fabric.

This outfit balances professional polish with creative comfort, perfectly suiting an autumn office environment where warmth and texture are key. The dark denim trousers ground the look in everyday practicality while the oversized wool blazer adds the refined edge of neat dressing without feeling stifling. Neutral tones like charcoal, oat cream, and blackened oak create a cohesive palette that works well with changing fall light, while the metallic accessories provide just enough sparkle for a creative workspace.
